name: img-to-pixel
description: Turns a reference image into 64x64 pixel art with approval at each step (description -> 3 generated variations -> pixel retouch -> export HTML/PNG/SVG with and without background).

interface.longDescription: Describe a reference image, generate 3 pixel art variations with native image generation, pick one, retouch pixel by pixel and export HTML/PNG/SVG with and without background.
defaultPrompt: Transforma esta imagem em pixel art 64x64
